notes.title: REGISTA 0.8.5 - A LOT MORE STATISTICS!
notes.notes: [p]Hello managers,[/p][p][/p][p]Today's patch focuses on improvements in gameplay and visual understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the full changelog.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Before starting the match, the opponent team now have a preset tactic and a fully shown lineup.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more visuals to match icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Offside goals now appear right below the scores.[/p][/*][*][p]The transfer season budget is now reset at the end of every season.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 25 more match texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs related to preset tactical formations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new assets to the transfer season.[/p][/*][*][p]Added subtitles to the intro cinematic for all supported languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some situations where texts appear incorrectly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: REGISTA 0.8.3 - Lineup Screen Improvements
notes.notes:
[p]Hello managers,[/p][p][/p][p]It's been only four days since we released Regista, and you have already provided us with a lot of feedback to work on. We are thankful for that and have begun improving the gameplay experience already.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting with the Lineup panel, many of our players have requested more visible statistics for our team because our strategies do not feel impactful enough. We are already keeping track of these statistics and are now making them all visible one by one. [/p][p]
Here is how it looks like right now,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210715/837dd4e22f4dfe51d37c590a88200edbd5167c7a.png"][/img][/p][p]From now on, we will be following a path where we will make every calculation that we do in the background visible to all managers.[/p][p][/p][p]You can see the full changelog below,[/p][list][*][p]Improved the effect when the Metric Boost item does not provide enough directions on what to do.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some button assets that are appearing incorrectly in some scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Minimal improvements on the card appearance experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple of typing errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more definitions to some icons (Transfer Budget, Total Fans)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Regista - Day 1 Patch
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for the interest that you have shown in Regista! [/p][p][/p][p]With your comments and feedback, you have been delivering through Steam Discussions, Discord and social media, we are delivering a better experience of Regista. We will consistently continue to develop Regista with you, Managers.[/p][p][/p][p]Below, you can find the changelog for this day 1 patch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with follow-up cards overlapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Aftermatch event cards will always appear in the first card after the match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a preset tactic is forced back to 4-3-3 after every match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple of content issues on the cards.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: REGISTA is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Managers, the wait is FINALLY over, and the match day has come! [/p][p][/p][p]Step into the shoes of a football club owner and a manager, and lead your team from the amateur leagues to the top tier of professional football. In this unique and strategic card-based management sim, every decision you make matters. Will you bribe the referee to secure a win? Fire a key member of your staff to balance the books? Or make a last-minute transfer to boost your team's morale? The fate of your club is in your hands.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What you can look forward to:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strategic Card-Based Gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Customise your club[/p][/*][*][p]Simulated tactical matches[/p][/*][*][p]Transfers, seasonal reports[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Regista is Getting a Story Mode!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Aspiring Managers,[/p][p]After collecting the feedback from the demo players, we have decided to add one big spice to the game, and it is the STORY MODE! We have already begun working on it to further expand the player experience of the Regista.[/p][p]We're already hard at work crafting a narrative experience that will add a whole new layer of depth and motivation to your managerial journey. Prepare to be more invested than ever as you lead your club.[/p][p]To tease it a little, we will be getting our sweet revenge from a first-tier football club... Maybe a club that [b]we worked with[/b] previously?[/p][p]Here is an initial storyboard for our new addition to give you more ideas about it, and we are curious to see if you can understand the full context from this![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rXZkIFvue2M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates on the development of our story mode, as well as the "Future of Regista" post detailing the mechanical changes and additions inspired by your demo feedback.[/p]

notes.title: A Huge Thank You!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Managers,[/p][p]The Next Fest has officially come to a close, and we are so happy to see the interest in the [i]Regista[/i] demo. We would like to thank the [b]over 1,000 unique demo testers[/b] who took the time to step into the manager's office and lead their clubs.[/p][p]Also, the feedback has been pouring in, [b]over 100 detailed feedback submissions[/b]. We read through every single comment, suggestion, and bug report. It shaped our roadmap as we progress through the release of Regista. A huge thank you for that too.[/p][p][b]So, what's next?[/b][/p][p]With this collected feedback, we are now deciding which features we should include in the game and not. In the coming days, we will be publishing a detailed "Future of Regista" post. This will outline the [b]set-in-stone changes and improvements[/b] that you can expect to see in the full release of the game, all thanks to your suggestions.[/p][p][b]And one more thing to tease some additions...[/b][/p][p]To strengthen the roleplay, we wanted to ignite the urge to continue even more, and we are adding [b]a story mode![/b] We will also be sharing an update for this feature in the coming days. It's one of the many features that will be added to the game and excite you to progress in the journey.[/p][p]Thank you once again for an incredible Next Fest. If you want to contribute more to the Regista directly, you are all welcome to our [url="https://discord.gg/9mbbfzezdv"]Discord[/url] server to discuss everything. Stay tuned for future updates![/p]

notes.title: Regista Steam Next Fest Update
notes.notes: [h1]The Next Fest Update Patch Notes[/h1][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Today, we're excited to roll out a major update packed with new features and improvements to our demo. Let's dive into the patch notes![/p][p]This update introduces a deeper level of strategy and management, along with a host of other enhancements to enrich your experience.[/p][h3]Introducing the Morale System[/h3][p]We're taking player management to a whole new level. Every player on your squad now has a morale level that directly impacts their performance on the pitch. Your decisions as a manager will have a direct impact on their performances. A happy and motivated squad will push for those crucial wins, while a demoralized team might crumble under pressure and perform poorly. Choose your actions wisely; the fate of your club hangs in the balance.[/p][h3]Preset Tactics System: Your Strategy, Your Way[/h3][p]To give you more control over your team's on-field strategy, we've implemented a brand-new Preset Tactics System. You can now define your strongest lineups and tactical approaches for Defensive (5-4-1), Balanced (4-4-2), and Offensive (4-3-3) playstyles. In the future, you will have the option to make your own unique formation.[/p][h3]A World of New Content[/h3][p]The world of Regista is now richer and more dynamic than ever before:[/p][list][*][p]All Encounters Updated: We've reviewed and refreshed all in-game encounters to provide more varied and interesting challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]New Characters and Event Types: Get ready to meet new personalities and navigate unexpected situations with a range of new event types.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Match Texts: We've added more variety to the in-match commentary to bring the action to life.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Polishing the Experience[/h3][p]We're committed to delivering a polished and enjoyable experience for all players:[/p][list][*][p]Localization Updates: We've updated our localization in all supported languages to ensure a clearer and more immersive experience for our global community.[/p][/*][*][p]Added New SFX and VFX: Enjoy a more vibrant and responsive game with the addition of new sound effects and visual flourishes.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Tutorial: We've refined the tutorial to provide a smoother and more informative introduction for new players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]And for a Little Fun...[/h3][p]For those moments when you need a quick break from the pressures of management, we've added a couple of fun mini-games to the ESC Menu:[/p][list][*][p]Reflex Time Test: Test your reaction speed![/p][/*][*][p]Ball Bounce: A simple, classic distraction.[/p][/*][/list][p]We're incredibly excited for you to get your hands on this updated demo during the Steam Next Fest. Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue to develop and refine Regista: Reign Your Football Club. So jump in, start your managerial career, and let us know what you think![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p]
